title_en: APARTMENT 2+1+2 FOR SALE AT SHESHI AQPONJA
description_en: The 2+1+2 apartment is located on the 3rd floor of an 8-story building in the Laprak area at the former Shqiponja Square. Tirana Face The strategic location in the New Ring, at the Shqiponja square roundabout, is the new center for housing, business and institutions, is another added value. The project is connected to the Great Ring of the capital and has direct access to all new rings and entrances/exits from Tirana, which makes its position one of the main advantages. • Net area: 91.81 m² • Gross area: 102.83 m² • Floor: 3rd floor or 5th from the ground, view from the main street • 1 living room together with the kitchen area, 2 bedrooms, 1 spacious balcony with access from the living room and one of the bedrooms, 1 bathroom • Regular floor plan • Possibility to purchase post parking at an extra price • Suitable for residence or investment in a sought-after area of Tirana • The building has just been completed and occupancy has begun while the apartment is in the refinishing phase. • For more information, please contact us!
